name: Redtape Ltd
title: Redtape Ltd - 543957 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA 19.4% and FY26 revenue INR2,415 crore (+19.6%), but inventory still ~170 days, payables fell sharply and management was evasive on payables, margins and apparel economics.

triggers.label: Inventory days ~250 → ~170, target 150
triggers.quote: it has come down from almost 250 days to 170 days right now. And the ideal situation is to keep it to 150 days.

triggers.label: Gross margin shrink from rebate accounting
triggers.quote: the gross margin, you can see the shrinkage came because of the top-line, and not basically because anything we had done differently this year.

guidance.quote: And the ideal situation is to keep it to 150 days. That is what we are trying to do.
We are planning to add almost 200 to 250 stores.
we are taking a very safe route of saying it should always be in the 16% to 19% range

red_flags.label: Payables days cut sharply, unexplained
red_flags.quote: I think, we'll have to come back on this. We'll have to come back on this.

red_flags.label: Other income ~INR133 cr from marketplace rebates
red_flags.quote: the basic component of that is the discount, rebate and discount, which you get from the e-commerce platforms.

red_flags.label: Inventory ~170 days, no provisioning policy
red_flags.quote: We don't do as such any provisioning

red_flags.label: Apparel/category margin not disclosed
red_flags.quote: we have not calculated margin as per the category

evasions.quote: I think, we'll have to come back on this. We'll have to come back on this.
we have not calculated margin as per the category , because everything for us is under the same umbrella.
That's a forward-looking question. We would just like to say that we will continue in the same vein
I will not be very sure about it, I ’ll not like to put my thumb on it
